hypothesis: Under an FEP-flavored 'substrate is reducing its own prediction error' framing (RSI claim), the per-session correction-count on Amanda's correction-open ledger should show a monotone-decay trend (Mann-Kendall tau < 0, p < 0.05). If stationary or increasing, prediction-error is not improving -> RSI claim falsified.

session_definition_chosen.primary: amanda.Correction.open.v<N> rotation event. Each archived version represents a session-bounded compaction. Index = chronological version number (v2..v8 = sessions 1..7). Timestamps recovered from GENESIS observation strings inside each entity ('GENESIS YYYY-MM-DD ...').
session_definition_chosen.rationale: Correction.open.v* rotation has higher granularity (7 events) than session_handoff vault (6 files, mostly fork markers). Rotation is the actual substrate-compaction signal — when correction-obs>10 watchdog fires, the substrate is forced to triage.
rejected_alternatives: amanda.State.v* rotation (16 versions) — superset, but the question is specifically about CORRECTION count, not State entropy. State rotates for other reasons too.
/home/joey/.gnosis/vault/session_handoff/*.md — only 6 files, mostly 2026-05-27 forks, not session-cycle markers.

input_mtimes_utc./home/joey/.gnosis/.memory/memory.jsonl: captured at run time inside results JSON

correction_count_metric.primary: n_substantive_observations_at_rotation: extracted from the ARCHIVED observation of v<N-1> OR the GENESIS observation of v<N>, both of which report the count of 'substantive obs' that the predecessor held at compaction time. This is the count that triggered the watchdog rotation.
correction_count_metric.secondary: n_live_observations: total observations currently held by entity (includes GENESIS + ARCHIVED metadata bullets, not just substantive corrections).

method_summary: 1) Parse memory.jsonl, locate amanda.Correction.open.v2..v8. 2) For each version, extract GENESIS timestamp from its observations[0] string, and the predecessor's 'substantive obs' count reported there. 3) Build time series x=session_index (1..N), y=correction_count. 4) Run Mann-Kendall trend test (scipy.stats.kendalltau on (index, count) — equivalent to MK under no x-ties). 5) Run lag-1 autocorrelation. 6) Run OLS slope + bootstrap-CI. 7) Verdict: RSI_FEP_NOT_FALSIFIED iff (tau<0 AND p<0.05); else RSI_FEP_FALSIFIED. INDETERMINATE iff N<5 or all-same.

falsifier_predicates.F5_robustness: report OLS slope, R^2, bootstrap-resampled 95% CI on slope

decision_rule: RSI_FEP_NOT_FALSIFIED iff F1 AND F2 AND F3 pass. RSI_FEP_FALSIFIED iff F1 AND F2 pass but F3 fails. HARNESS_INVALID iff F1 or F2 fails. INDETERMINATE iff borderline (e.g., 0.05 < p < 0.10).
default_on_uncertainty: RSI_FEP_FALSIFIED (brutal honesty — burden of proof on the decay claim)
